patch.seo_title_zh: 函馆山夜景｜缆车票种、检修期与上山安排
patch.seo_description_zh: 规划函馆山夜景前先核对缆车运行、往返及单程票种和季节末班。2026年10月20日至11月8日检修停运；附官方查询入口。
patch.description:
## 夜景怎么安排
函馆山可以俯看城市与两侧海湾。若想同时观察白天与入夜后的变化，可把它留作港区行程的傍晚一站；能见度与交通运行比固定的拍照时刻更重要。

## 缆车票种与开放安排
截至2026-10-30核实，运营方公布普通成人（初中生及以上）往返¥1,800、单程¥1,200；儿童往返¥900、单程¥600。这是缆车乘车费，不能写成函馆山所有区域的统一门票。幼儿免费人数有附加条件，带孩子时应查官方票种说明。

重要日期：2026年10月20日至11月8日缆车因法定整备检修全天停运。常规营业时段不适用于这段日期。非检修日也应核对当日风况、季节末班及现场购票截止安排。

## 交通与停留建议
搭缆车时导航至山麓站；检修期间可从官方交通页查看函馆山登山巴士，再按出行日核实班次。编辑建议为山顶观景预留约45–60分钟，另加上下山与候车时间；这是规划参考，不是官方游览时长或排队保证。离开前确认下山交通，避免只看上行末班。

运营与票价来源：[函馆山缆车官网](https://334.co.jp/)、[票价与时段](https://334.co.jp/ropeway/price/)。交通交叉参考：[函馆官方旅游指南](https://www.hakodate.travel/en/information/mt-hakodate/)。

englishProposal.description:
## Planning the view
Mount Hakodate overlooks the city between two bays. Consider an evening visit after exploring the waterfront, with flexibility for visibility and transport.

## Ropeway tickets and maintenance
Checked on 2026-10-30: standard adult fares (junior high school and above) are JPY 1,800 return or JPY 1,200 one way; child fares are JPY 900 return or JPY 600 one way. These are ropeway fares, not a general admission fee for the mountain. Check the operator's conditions for younger children.

The ropeway is closed for maintenance from 20 October to 8 November 2026. Regular hours do not apply during this closure. Check the operator's daily status and the seasonal last ascent and descent before travelling.

## Access and time allowance
Use the Sanroku station for the ropeway. During maintenance, consult the official access page for the mountain bus and verify the timetable for your travel date. An editorial allowance of 45–60 minutes at the viewpoint excludes travel and queues; it is not an official duration or a queue estimate.

[Operator](https://334.co.jp/) · [Fares](https://334.co.jp/ropeway/price/) · [Official city travel guide](https://www.hakodate.travel/en/information/mt-hakodate/)

patch.seo_title_zh: 札幌时计台｜馆内看点、票种与最后入馆时间
patch.seo_description_zh: 区分时计台外观拍照与馆内参观，整理成人及学生票种、17:00最后入馆和元旦休馆日；按官方信息安排札幌市区散步。
patch.description:
## 外观与馆内看什么
札幌时计台原为札幌农学校演武场，适合放入市中心步行行程。一楼有历史展示，二楼保留讲堂空间并展示同类时钟机械；街边看外观与购票入馆是两种不同的安排，傍晚外观亮灯不代表馆内继续开放。

## 门票与开放时间
截至2026-10-30核实，官方公布开放时间为08:45–17:10，最后入馆17:00；1月1日至3日休馆。普通成人¥350，大学生凭学生证¥150，小学至高中学生免费，中学生及高中生需出示学生证。团体和减免有独立条件，请按自身资格查看入馆指南。

## 交通与停留建议
地址为札幌市中央区北1条西2丁目，可结合札幌站与大通一带步行路线，用页面地图导航到具体入口。馆方没有普通停车场，自驾需另找附近付费停车位。编辑建议入馆参观预留约30–45分钟；只拍外观可自行缩短，这不是官方规定时长。

## 到访注意
历史建筑馆内无空调，盛夏需留意热度；冬季也应穿保暖衣物。需要无障碍协助时先联系馆方确认入口与升降设备。资料与票价可能调整，出发前查看[官方入馆指南](https://sapporoshi-tokeidai.jp/inspect/guide.php)，并可对照[札幌官方旅游介绍](https://www.sapporo.travel/spot/facility/clock_tower/)。

englishProposal.description:
## Outside and inside
Sapporo Clock Tower was the former drill hall of Sapporo Agricultural College. The first floor presents its history, while the upper hall includes a related clock mechanism. Viewing the exterior and visiting the museum are different activities; evening illumination does not extend museum admission.

## Admission and hours
Checked on 2026-10-30: hours are 08:45–17:10, with last admission at 17:00. The museum closes on 1–3 January. Standard adult admission is JPY 350; university students pay JPY 150 with student ID. School pupils through high school enter free; junior high and high school students must show ID. Consult the official guide for group and concession conditions.

## Access and visit planning
The address is Kita 1-jo Nishi 2-chome, Chuo-ku, Sapporo. Use the map when combining it with a central city walk. There is no ordinary visitor car park. An editorial allowance of 30–45 minutes for the museum is a planning suggestion, not an official duration.

[Official admission guide](https://sapporoshi-tokeidai.jp/inspect/guide.php) · [Official Sapporo travel guide](https://www.sapporo.travel/spot/facility/clock_tower/)

patch.seo_title_zh: 新仓山浅间公园｜下吉田到达、398级阶梯与游览安排
patch.seo_description_zh: 区分下吉田站到公园入口与忠灵塔的步行时间，了解398级阶梯及富士山观景安排；停车价格存在官方资料冲突，出发前需再核实。
patch.description:
## 看点与体力安排
新仓山浅间公园的展望区可以将忠灵塔、城市与富士山放在同一视野。到达这里包含一段登高：从神社一带上行的主要阶梯共有398级。能否看清富士山仍取决于云量，照片中的景观不是每天都能保证。

## 从下吉田怎么到达
富士吉田旅游页将下吉田站到忠灵塔的步行写为约25分钟；山梨旅游页约10–15分钟的说明指向公园入口，两个终点不同，不能把入口时间当成已登上展望区的总时间。请按体力、阶梯与现场人流另留余量。

## 开放与停留建议
截至2026-10-30核实，两处旅游资料均列公园可24小时进入；山梨旅游资料列公园入场免费。开放不代表全天都有相同照明、交通或现场服务。编辑建议从入口起预留约60–90分钟用于上下行与观景，旺季另留余量；这不是官方时长或排队预测。

## 停车与注意事项
停车信息暂不作为确定价格发布：富士吉田旅游页列多个收费停车场，并链接2025年起的收费安排；山梨页面仍出现免费停车说明。开车前需以市方最新停车公告及现场收费牌再核实。附近道路较窄，大巴不能按普通小车路线直接开到公园停车场，应遵守指定上下客与停车要求。

来源：[富士吉田旅游页](https://fujiyoshida.net/spot/12)、[山梨旅游页](https://www.yamanashi-kankou.jp/kankou/spot/p1_4919.html)。

englishProposal.description:
## Viewpoint and climb
Arakurayama Sengen Park combines views of the pagoda, Fujiyoshida and Mount Fuji. The main stairway from the shrine area has 398 steps. Visibility depends on the weather.

## Access from Shimoyoshida
Fujiyoshida's tourism page gives about 25 minutes on foot from Shimoyoshida Station to the pagoda. Yamanashi's shorter estimate refers to the park entrance, not the completed climb to the viewpoint. Allow extra time for the ascent and crowds.

## Hours and planning
Checked on 2026-10-30: both tourism pages list 24-hour park access; Yamanashi lists free park entry. This does not promise continuous lighting or visitor services. An editorial allowance of 60–90 minutes from the entrance covers walking and viewing, excluding additional peak-season delays.

## Parking needs verification
The two official tourism pages disagree: Fujiyoshida lists paid car parks, while Yamanashi still mentions free parking. Recheck the city's current notice and signs before driving. No parking tariff is proposed here.

[Fujiyoshida tourism](https://fujiyoshida.net/spot/12) · [Yamanashi tourism](https://www.yamanashi-kankou.jp/kankou/spot/p1_4919.html)

patch.seo_title_zh: 小樽音乐盒堂本馆｜店铺看点、楼层关闭与到店安排
patch.seo_description_zh: 识别住吉町4-1的小樽音乐盒堂本馆，区分零售本馆、其他分馆与手作体验；核对营业时间和楼层提前关闭安排。
patch.description:
## 先认清本馆
本页地址对应小樽音乐盒堂本馆（小樽オルゴール堂 本館），是设在历史建筑内的音乐盒专门店。中文常称八音盒博物馆，但规划时应按本馆店铺定位，不要误以为所有分馆、古董展示和手作体验都在同一地点。门前蒸汽钟可作辨认地标；现有正文关于『全球仅存两座』的说法没有获得本次来源支持，建议删除。

## 看什么与怎么逛
可以先看建筑与蒸汽钟，再按兴趣浏览不同音乐盒款式。若要亲手制作音乐盒，店方另列『手作体验游工房』；应先核对该店位置、项目、预约与费用，不能把制作活动当成本馆入店附送服务。

## 营业与交通
截至2026-10-30核实，店方列本馆09:00–18:00，二楼与三楼17:45关闭，无固定休息日；临时调整仍应查店方公告。地址为北海道小樽市住吉町4番1号，与小樽旅游协会本馆条目一致。旅游协会列无停车场，自驾不要将附近道路当成店方专用停车位。

## 停留与费用
编辑建议为本馆浏览预留约30–45分钟，购物或另约制作活动需另外安排。这不是官方规定时长。本次未取得可确认本馆入店门票的明确条款，不在票价字段填¥0，也不推算制作费用。

来源：[店方各分馆说明](https://www.otaru-orgel.co.jp/shop)、[小樽旅游协会本馆条目](https://otaru.gr.jp/shop/orgel-doh-mainbuilding)。

englishProposal.description:
## Identify the Main Hall
The address on this page corresponds to Otaru Orgel Doh Main Hall, a music-box specialist shop in a historic building. Do not assume that other branches, antique displays and workshops are all in the same place. The steam clock is a useful landmark. The claim that only two such clocks exist worldwide has not been substantiated and is omitted.

## What to plan
Browse the building and music boxes according to your interests. The operator lists a separate DIY workshop branch; check its location, booking conditions and fees before planning an activity.

## Hours and access
Checked on 2026-10-30: the operator lists 09:00–18:00, with the second and third floors closing at 17:45, and no regular closing day. Check for temporary changes. The address is 4-1 Sumiyoshicho, Otaru. The local tourism association lists no car park.

Allow around 30–45 minutes for browsing as an editorial planning suggestion. Shopping and workshops need separate time. An explicit Main Hall admission policy was not confirmed, so no zero-price ticket or workshop fee is proposed.

[Operator](https://www.otaru-orgel.co.jp/shop) · [Otaru tourism association](https://otaru.gr.jp/shop/orgel-doh-mainbuilding)
